hypothesis: LibNC unfused softmax, indexed-log, sum, and mean-scaling backward produces a reproducible per-logit gradient contract that differs materially from PyTorch fused cross-entropy and explains the cancellation-amplified internal sign flips.
interfaces_exposed: Direct LibNC nc_soft_max plus nc_indexed_log gradients -> frozen cross-entropy backward contracts
kill_condition: Retire the loss-graph backward as the cause if fused PyTorch matches within 2e-6, no alternative uniquely matches, or the direct probe is nondeterministic; do not sweep logits, targets, tolerance, or loss scaling.
promotion_condition: Authorize one bound miniature replay using the uniquely matched loss backward only if the direct 256-by-4 LibNC probabilities and logit gradients repeat byte-identically and one frozen contract uniquely matches within 2e-6.
rejection_reason: Direct LibNC loss graph repeated exactly, and fused PyTorch cross-entropy matched all logit gradients within 9.32e-10. Retire softmax-indexed-log backward as the cause.
retired_neighborhoods: Output matmul reduction; combined GELU and RMSNorm repair; self-consistent approximate ROCm model.
title: NNCP v3.3 LibNC softmax-indexed-log backward parity
